origin.description: The caller stores a Dots sequence in _dots.
origin.details: A caller with no _dots is an error, including an empty call that never set _dots.
origin.example:
bp_...length <- getFromNamespace("...length", "backports")
foo <- function(...) bp_...length()
print(foo(1, 2, 3))
